rules.close_AC_orientation: Diagonal (6 runs) vs horizontal (4 runs, 2026-11-22/r3/lab-a/009-012) K_AC and K_CA: publishable only if |gap| <= 5%, SE of pooled mean <= 3%, and no run more than 10% from pooled mean. Otherwise close-AC stays held and orientation is scoped.
rules.close_CC_vertical: Vertical mean K_CC vs horizontal mean 9.50 (2026-11-21/r1/lab-a/003, 004). Gap within 5% (9.03 to 9.98): close-CC isotropy supported at this precision. Gap at or below -5%: horizontal value is an orientation outlier; scope close-CC to horizontal.
rules.N9_long_time: Uniform pairwise-sum A-A law (K 17.7, P 2.5, from P-0003) on 2026-11-23/r1/lab-a/019-020. RMSE/L <= 0.01 on both runs: pairwise sum holds at T 10 for N=9 (supports crowd-8 claim at T up to 10). 0.01 < RMSE/L <= 0.024: inconclusive, claim not published. RMSE/L > 0.024 on either run: uniform pairwise sum refuted at T 10; no crowd claim.
rules.AA_distance_law: K_AA at separation 7 and 9 (fits of 021-024) vs 17.7. Within 5%: constant-K law supported at 7 and 9. Otherwise report the ratio; no claim on the crowd model that depends on it.
